credits.title: Mate's Rate
credits.overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

credits.title: Gina
credits.overview: Gina wants to get attention from her busy father through a report of harrasment from one of her schoolteachers.

credits.title: Haunted Hotel
credits.overview: After a family went bankrupt and lost their house, they have to move to a haunted hotel.

credits.title: Jomblo
credits.overview: Four single college mates try their luck in love by taking a stab at dating, leading them to humiliating, cringeworthy, and formative experiences.

credits.title: Gie
credits.overview: Indonesian activist Soe Hok Gie experiences a political awakening during the tumultuous regimes of Soeharto and Soekarno.

credits.title: Ultra Violet
credits.overview: The loves of a struggling photographer and a bus ticket clerk are inextricably tied together after a chance encounter.
